chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch.124: Li Huowang Wakes Up to a Trap
chapter_meta_description: Poisoned and stabbed while hallucinating, Li Huowang wakes to a silent, hostile Ao-Jing Sect. He must find the traitor before his body fails him.
og_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian: The Silent Verdict of the Ao-Jing Cult
og_description: A brutal chapter of quiet terror. Li Huowang is poisoned, wounded, and forced to watch the cruel punishment of the one person who tried to help him.
twitter_title: Li Huowang is bleeding out and the cultists won't stop staring.
twitter_description: The Ao-Jing Sect's silence is a weapon. Li Huowang vomits iron pellets and must navigate a nest of snakes where the only friendly face is being flayed alive.
